chunks: The quickest evil to be punished is oppression.

key_terms.الشَّرِّ: evil; wrongdoing in a moral sense
key_terms.الْبَغْيُ: oppression; transgression and unjust overstepping against others
key_terms.عُقُوبَةً: punishment; requital for a sinful act

ai.seo_question: Which sin is punished most quickly in Islam?
ai.summary: This concise saying teaches that oppression is among the sins whose punishment comes swiftly. It warns against transgression against others and highlights the grave moral consequences of injustice in this world and the Hereafter.
